name: Warrens

civilopediaText.text: Beneath the Clan of Embers' settlements stretches a maze of crowded tunnels and rough-hewn chambers. Orcs and goblins emerge from these warrens in great numbers, allowing the Clan to raise armies far faster than its rivals. Every eligible living unit trained in a city with Warrens is accompanied by a second unit of the same type; heroes and national units, along with mechanical and nonliving units, do not benefit. The teeming warrens also strain the city's administration and upkeep.
Gameplay note: Warrens increase building maintenance by 10% and have 1 Gold base upkeep in this Unciv adaptation. ExtraModMod Continued instead increases overall city maintenance by 10%.
